adminUnits_description: Every house in the complex, its block and number, together with how many occupants are active right now. A unit is never deleted, only deactivated.
adminUnits_invalidForm: Invalid request: block and number are required.
adminUnits_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage units.
profile_subheading: Update your own name and phone number.
profile_phoneHint: Leave blank if you do not want to give a phone number yet.
profile_noRecordBody: Your account is not linked to any resident record in this complex yet. Contact the management to be registered to your unit.
profile_notifications_subheading: Choose which emails you want to receive. Some notification kinds cannot be turned off.
profile_notifications_kind_invoiceIssued: Email when your unit's monthly invoice is issued.
profile_notifications_kind_paymentVerifi: Email when a payment you sent has been verified by the management.
profile_notifications_kind_ownComplaintS: Email when the status of a complaint you filed changes.
profile_notifications_kind_monthlyReport: Email when the complex's monthly financial report is published.
profile_notifications_kind_newPost_descr: Email when a new announcement or activity is posted on the board.
adminOccupancies_heading: Occupancy history of unit block {block} number {number}
adminOccupancies_description: Who lived in this house over which stretch of time, and who is responsible for its invoices. An occupancy is never deleted, only ended.
adminOccupancies_empty: No occupancy has been recorded for this unit yet.
adminOccupancies_noResidents: No resident has been recorded yet, so there is nobody to attach to this unit.
adminOccupancies_setPrimarySuccess: The unit's primary occupant was set.
adminOccupancies_conflict: This unit already has a primary occupant over those days: {resident}, since {startedOn}. End that occupancy first.
adminOccupancies_dateOrder: The end date {endedOn} is earlier than the start date {startedOn}.
adminOccupancies_invalidForm: Invalid request: resident, occupancy role and start date are all required and must be well formed.
adminOccupancies_invalidEndForm: Invalid request: the end date is required, in YYYY-MM-DD form.
adminOccupancies_residentNotFound: The chosen resident was not found.
adminOccupancies_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage occupancies.
myUnit_subheading: The houses recorded in your name, together with the occupants recorded in them.
myUnit_noRecordBody: Your account is not linked to any resident record in this complex yet. Contact the management to be registered to your house.
myUnit_emptyBody: No occupancy has been recorded in your name yet. Contact the management if that does not match reality.
myUnit_endedNote: Your occupancy of this house has ended, so its current occupants are not shown.
adminPosts_description: The complex's activities and announcements. Drafts are visible only on this page; published posts can be opened by anyone without an account. A post is never deleted, only archived.
adminPosts_empty: No post matches this filter yet.
adminPosts_new_description: A new post is always saved as a draft first. You can preview it and publish it once it has been saved.
adminPosts_form_summaryHint: One or two sentences. This is what appears in the list and in the notification email.
adminPosts_form_bodyHint: Written in Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, lists, links, quotes and tables. Images inside the body are not shown — use the cover image below.
adminPosts_form_eventHint: Only filled in for an activity. An announcement may not have a time or a place.
adminPosts_previewHint: The preview shows the body as a resident reads it. The status does not change.
adminPosts_coverHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 256 KB. Shrink a photo from a phone camera first.
adminPosts_publishedMessage: The post is now on the announcement board.
adminPosts_archivedMessage: The post was archived and no longer appears on the announcement board.
adminPosts_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage posts.
adminPosts_invalidForm: Invalid request: title, summary and body are required.
adminPosts_invalidTime: The start time or the end time could not be read.
adminPosts_transitionRefused: A post with status {from} cannot be moved to {to}.
adminPosts_rule_announcementHasEventTime: An announcement may not have a start time, an end time or a location.
adminPosts_rule_eventNeedsStartTime: An activity needs a start time.
adminPosts_rule_endsBeforeStart: The end time cannot be earlier than the start time.
adminPosts_rule_unknownCategory: That category is not one this application knows.
adminPosts_rule_authorNotRegistered: Your account is not linked to a resident record yet, so a post cannot be attributed to you. Contact a Superuser.
adminPosts_rule_coverImageNotAnImage: That file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
adminPosts_rule_coverImageTooLarge: The cover image is larger than 256 KB.
postPublic_pageDescription: The complex's published activities and announcements, open to anyone without an account.
postPublic_description: Upcoming activities appear first, followed by the latest announcements. Use the filters to see past ones or narrow by category.
postPublic_empty: No activity or announcement matches this filter yet.
postPublic_notFound: This post was not found or has not been published.
